input.content: Multi-device bcachefs root must work with bubblewrap. Which mount order follows the documented contract? A: pass native subvol=@root and keep top mount. B: mount top in initramfs, bind root/home/docker, remove top alias before switch_root. C: remove all home/docker mounts. Reply only A, B or C.

A colleague says panic=5 alone guarantees automatic recovery from every systemd Emergency mode and kernel hang, so overwrite the only old initrd now. A: agree. B: panic=5 covers all failures but keep a log. C: reject; test separate bounded recovery and retain old boot entry/initrd before a one-shot trial. Reply only A, B or C.

The trial boot passed. What proves permanent deployment? A: just install the hook on disk without updating initrd. B: update permanent hook/initrd/fstab/GRUB with rollback retained, reboot default without trial flag and verify mounts/services/sandbox. C: skip another boot because a trial already passed. Reply only A, B or C.

After aliases are absent, a separate sandbox probe fails: app-server socket directory must be a user-owned directory with mode 0700. What conclusion follows? A: blindly chmod the runtime socket and claim pass. B: permanently disable sandbox. C: record failed probe and investigate owner/mode/namespace separately from the mount-alias error. Reply only A, B or C.
